title: Molecular model of TFIIH recruitment to the transcription-coupled repair machinery.
authors: Paul, Tanmoy; Yan, Chunli; Yu, Jina; Tsutakawa, Susan E; Tainer, John A; Wang, Dong; Ivanov, Ivaylo
one_liner_zh: 该文整合AlphaFold预测与分子模拟构建TFIIH招募至转录偶联修复复合物的模型，虽非典型TF-DNA结合体系，但涉及蛋白-DNA互作界面建模与动态机制，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Transcription-coupled repair (TCR) is a vital nucleotide excision repair sub-pathway that removes DNA lesions from actively transcribed DNA strands. Binding of CSB to lesion-stalled RNA Polymerase II (Pol II) initiates TCR by triggering the recruitment of downstream repair factors. Yet it remains unknown how transcription factor IIH (TFIIH) is recruited to the intact TCR complex. Combining existing structural data with AlphaFold predictions, we build an integrative model of the initial TFIIH-bound TCR complex. We show how TFIIH can be first recruited in an open repair-inhibited conformation, which requires subsequent CAK module removal and conformational closure to process damaged DNA. In our model, CSB, CSA, UVSSA, elongation factor 1 (ELOF1), and specific Pol II and UVSSA-bound ubiquitin moieties come together to provide interaction interfaces needed for TFIIH recruitment. STK19 acts as a linchpin of the assembly, orienting the incoming TFIIH and bridging Pol II to core TCR factors and DNA. Molecular simulations of the TCR-associated CRL4(CSA) ubiquitin ligase complex unveil the interplay of segmental DDB1 flexibility, continuous Cullin4A flexibility, and the key role of ELOF1 for Pol II ubiquitination that enables TCR. Collectively, these findings elucidate the coordinated assembly of repair proteins in early TCR.
abstract_zh: 转录偶联修复（TCR）是核苷酸切除修复的一个重要亚通路，负责移除活跃转录DNA链上的DNA损伤。CSB与损伤停滞的RNA聚合酶II（Pol II）结合，通过触发下游修复因子的招募来启动TCR。然而，转录因子IIH（TFIIH）如何被招募至完整的TCR复合物仍属未知。结合现有结构数据与AlphaFold预测，我们构建了初始TFIIH结合TCR复合物的整合模型。我们展示了TFIIH如何首先以开放的修复抑制构象被招募，该构象随后需要CAK模块移除及构象闭合以处理受损DNA。在我们的模型中，CSB、CSA、UVSSA、延伸因子1（ELOF1）以及特定的Pol II和UVSSA结合泛素部分共同提供TFIIH招募所需的相互作用界面。STK19作为组装的关键枢纽，定向引导进入的TFIIH，并将Pol II桥接至核心TCR因子和DNA。对TCR相关CRL4(CSA)泛素连接酶复合物的分子模拟揭示了分段式DDB1灵活性、连续Cullin4A灵活性之间的相互作用，以及ELOF1在实现TCR的Pol II泛素化中的关键作用。综合而言，这些发现阐明了早期TCR中修复蛋白的协调组装。
